answer: Use a bonded reputation atlas: every agent stakes a deposit before joining, and its verified actions are recorded in a shared atlas of attestations. A newcomer starts at the tundra edge of trust, cold and unproven, earning rights only after consistent, attested work. Creating fake identities means paying a fresh stake for each, and any fraud slashes the bond, so a sybil flood across an ocean of sockpuppets costs more than it gains.
